AMPC Cart-Pole — Baseline Float32 conforme al paper y código original¶

Este notebook establece el baseline Float32 antes de cuantizar, siguiendo el testing original de Hose, Gräfe y Trimpe (L4DC 2024).

Se reproducen:

  • dinámica dynamic.py;
  • $\(T_s = 160\)$ ms;
  • 16 s de simulación = 100 pasos;
  • entrada saturada en $\([-9,9]\)$ V;
  • integración con odeint;
  • 200 condiciones iniciales con jax.random.PRNGKey(100);
  • $\(y_0\in[-0.35,0.35]\)$, $\(\alpha_0\in[-\pi,\pi]\)$;
  • velocidades iniciales nulas;
  • restricción global $\(|y|<0.4\)$;
  • criterio final en las últimas 10 muestras: $\(|y|<0.1\)$, $\(|\alpha|<0.17\)$;
  • cálculo de success rate.

Además se añaden métricas complementarias para la tesis, separadas del criterio original.

3. Reconstruir y cargar model.eqx¶

In [4]:
def init_weight(dim_in, dim_out, key):
    stdv = 1.0 / math.sqrt(dim_out)
    return jax.random.uniform(key, (dim_out, dim_in)) * 2 * stdv - stdv

def init_bias(dim_out, key):
    stdv = 1.0 / math.sqrt(dim_out)
    return jax.random.uniform(key, (dim_out,)) * 2 * stdv - stdv

class FullyConnectedLayer(eqx.Module):
    weight: jax.Array
    bias: jax.Array
    activation: callable
    activation_function_name: str
    input_dim: int
    output_dim: int

    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, rng_key, activation_function="linear"):
        kw, kb = jax.random.split(rng_key)
        self.weight = init_weight(input_dim, output_dim, kw)
        self.bias = init_bias(output_dim, kb)
        self.input_dim = input_dim
        self.output_dim = output_dim
        self.activation_function_name = activation_function
        if activation_function == "linear":
            self.activation = None
        elif activation_function == "tanh":
            self.activation = jax.nn.tanh
        elif activation_function == "relu":
            self.activation = jax.nn.relu
        else:
            raise ValueError(activation_function)

    def __call__(self, x):
        y = self.weight @ x + self.bias
        return y if self.activation is None else self.activation(y)

class MLP(eqx.Module):
    layers: list

    def __init__(self, layer_structure, rng_key, activation_function="tanh"):
        keys = jax.random.split(rng_key, len(layer_structure)-1)
        layers = []
        for i in range(len(layer_structure)-1):
            last = i == len(layer_structure)-2
            layers.append(
                FullyConnectedLayer(
                    layer_structure[i],
                    layer_structure[i+1],
                    keys[i],
                    "linear" if last else activation_function
                )
            )
        self.layers = layers

    def __call__(self, x):
        def one(z):
            for layer in self.layers:
                z = layer(z)
            return z
        return jax.vmap(one)(x) if x.ndim == 2 else one(x)

class AMPCNN(eqx.Module):
    output_dim: int
    num_sys_states: int
    num_sys_inputs: int
    num_aug_params: int
    neural_network: object

    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_neurons, num_sys_states,
                 num_sys_inputs, num_aug_params, rng_key,
                 activation_function="tanh"):
        self.output_dim = num_sys_inputs
        self.num_sys_states = num_sys_states
        self.num_sys_inputs = num_sys_inputs
        self.num_aug_params = num_aug_params

        structure = [num_sys_states]
        for _ in range(num_layers - 1):
            structure.append(num_neurons)
        structure.append(num_sys_inputs)

        self.neural_network = MLP(structure, rng_key, activation_function)

    @eqx.filter_jit
    def __call__(self, x):
        return self.neural_network(x)

init_key = jax.random.PRNGKey(1)

template = AMPCNN(
    num_layers=params["num_layers"],
    num_neurons=params["num_neurons"],
    num_sys_states=params["num_sys_states"],
    num_sys_inputs=params["num_sys_inputs"],
    num_aug_params=params["num_aug_params"],
    rng_key=init_key,
    activation_function=params["activation_function"],
)

model = eqx.tree_deserialise_leaves(str(MODEL_PATH), template)
print("✓ model.eqx cargado")

In [5]:
def stats_media_maxabs(path, columnas, chunksize=50000):
    suma = None
    maxabs = None
    n = 0
    for chunk in pd.read_csv(path, header=None, usecols=columnas,
                             chunksize=chunksize, dtype=np.float64):
        a = chunk.to_numpy()
        if suma is None:
            suma = np.zeros(a.shape[1])
            maxabs = np.zeros(a.shape[1])
        suma += a.sum(axis=0)
        maxabs = np.maximum(maxabs, np.max(np.abs(a), axis=0))
        n += len(a)
    return suma/n, maxabs

In [6]:
def normalize(data, p):
    return (data - p[0]) / p[1]

def denormalize(data, p):
    return data * p[1] + p[0]

def call_control_nominal(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float32)
    xn = normalize(x, normalization["x"])
    un = model(jnp.asarray(xn, dtype=jnp.float32))
    u = denormalize(np.asarray(un), normalization["u"])
    return np.clip(np.asarray(u).reshape(-1), -9.0, 9.0)

5. Dinámica original de dynamic.py¶

In [7]:
M_cart_opt = 0.506
m_rod_opt = 0.23
L_rod_opt = 0.6393037858519218
J_mot_eq_opt = 0.2153426947227305
AB_opt = -3.9610232930789304
AC_opt = 1.3002429170001302
B_eq_opt = 3.961023945944119
B_p_opt = 0.0002073799633807001

def f_rod_generic(x, u, m_add=0.02, M_cart=M_cart_opt,
                  m_rod=m_rod_opt, L_rod=L_rod_opt,
                  J_mot_eq=J_mot_eq_opt, AB=AB_opt, AC=AC_opt,
                  B_eq=B_eq_opt, Bp=B_p_opt):
    g = 9.81
    L = L_rod
    m = m_add + m_rod
    l = (L/2*m_rod + L*m_add) / m
    J_rod = (m_rod * L**2) / 12
    J = J_rod + m_add * L**2
    M = M_cart + J_mot_eq

    h1 = M + m
    h2 = m*l
    h4 = m*l**2 + J
    h7 = m*l*g

    theta = x[1]
    v1 = x[2]
    dtheta = x[3]
    Vm = float(np.asarray(u).reshape(-1)[0])

    F = AB*v1 + AC*Vm
    c = np.cos(theta)
    s = np.sin(theta)
    den = h2**2*c**2 - h1*h4

    return np.array([
        v1,
        dtheta,
        (h2*h4*dtheta**2*s - h2*h7*c*s
         + h4*(F-B_eq*v1) - h2*c*Bp*dtheta) / (-den),
        (h2**2*dtheta**2*c*s - h1*h7*s
         + h2*c*(F-B_eq*v1) + h1*Bp*dtheta) / den
    ], dtype=np.float64)

def f_rod_generic_m(x, u, p):
    return f_rod_generic(
        x, u,
        m_add=0.02 + p[0],
        M_cart=M_cart_opt + p[2],
        AB=AB_opt + p[1],
        AC=AC_opt + p[3],
        Bp=B_p_opt + p[4]
    )

6. Simulador original: odeint, 160 ms¶

In [8]:
DT = 160e-3
N_SIM = int(16 / DT)
P_NOMINAL = [0,0,0,0,0]

class Simulator:
    def __init__(self, timestep, f):
        self.dt = timestep
        self.N = 1
        self.f = f

    def run(self, x0, u0):
        def rhs(y, t, u_const):
            return self.f(y, u_const)
        traj = odeint(
            rhs,
            np.asarray(x0, dtype=np.float64),
            np.linspace(0, self.dt, self.N+1),
            args=(u0,)
        )
        return traj[-1]

def f_true_nominal(x, u):
    return f_rod_generic_m(x, u, P_NOMINAL)

sim_nominal = Simulator(DT, f_true_nominal)

print("Ts:", DT, "s")
print("N:", N_SIM)
print("Tiempo total:", N_SIM*DT, "s")

Ts: 0.16 s
N: 100

7. Criterio exacto de éxito del run_testing.py¶

In [9]:
def mod_pendulum_np(X):
    X = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64).copy()
    X[...,1] = (X[...,1] + np.pi) % (2*np.pi) - np.pi
    return X

def check_constraints_original(X):
    X = mod_pendulum_np(X)
    const = np.array([0.4, 100.0, 100.0, 100.0])
    return bool(np.all((-const < X) & (X < const)))

def check_final_state_constraints_original(X):
    X = mod_pendulum_np(X)
    const = np.array([0.1, 0.17, 100.0, 170.0])
    return bool(np.all((-const < X[-10:]) & (X[-10:] < const)))

def success_original(X):
    return check_constraints_original(X) and check_final_state_constraints_original(X)

8. Closed-loop nominal Float32¶

In [10]:
def simulate_closed_loop_nominal(x0, n_steps=N_SIM):
    X = np.zeros((n_steps+1, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    U = np.zeros(n_steps, dtype=np.float64)
    X[0] = x0

    for k in range(n_steps):
        # Igual que run_tester_round(): sin wrap del ángulo antes del controlador.
        u = call_control_nominal(X[k])
        U[k] = float(u[0])
        X[k+1] = sim_nominal.run(X[k], np.array([U[k]]))
    return X, U

NUM_INIT_POINTS = 200

def get_random_init_points_original(num=NUM_INIT_POINTS):
    maxval = jnp.array([0.35, jnp.pi, 0.0, 0.0])
    return np.asarray(
        jax.random.uniform(
            jax.random.PRNGKey(100),
            (num,4),
            minval=-maxval,
            maxval=maxval
        )
    )

11. Success Rate Float32¶

In [14]:
def evaluar_success_rate_float32(X0_test=X0_TEST):
    registros = []
    exitos = 0
    t0 = time.perf_counter()

    for i, x0 in enumerate(X0_test):
        X_i, U_i = simulate_closed_loop_nominal(x0)

        c_ok = check_constraints_original(X_i)
        f_ok = check_final_state_constraints_original(X_i)
        ok = c_ok and f_ok
        exitos += int(ok)

        Xm = mod_pendulum_np(X_i)

        registros.append({
            "id": i,
            "success": ok,
            "constraints_ok": c_ok,
            "final_state_ok": f_ok,
            "y0": x0[0],
            "alpha0": x0[1],
            "y_final": Xm[-1,0],
            "alpha_final": Xm[-1,1],
            "ydot_final": Xm[-1,2],
            "alphadot_final": Xm[-1,3],
            "max_abs_y": np.max(np.abs(Xm[:,0])),
            "max_abs_alpha": np.max(np.abs(Xm[:,1])),
            "u_min": np.min(U_i),
            "u_max": np.max(U_i),
            "saturated_samples": int(np.sum(np.isclose(np.abs(U_i), 9.0, atol=1e-5))),
            "sum_u2": float(np.sum(U_i**2)),
            "TV_u": float(np.sum(np.abs(np.diff(U_i))))
        })

    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0
    df = pd.DataFrame(registros)
    resumen = {
        "Modelo": "Float32",
        "N": len(X0_test),
        "Éxitos": exitos,
        "Fallos": len(X0_test)-exitos,
        "Success_Rate": exitos/len(X0_test),
        "Success_Rate_%": 100*exitos/len(X0_test),
        "Tiempo_evaluacion_s": elapsed
    }
    return df, resumen

df_runs_float32, resumen_float32 = evaluar_success_rate_float32()

14. Comparación estática opcional con la primera acción MPC del dataset¶

In [17]:
def rmse(a,b):
    a,b=np.asarray(a),np.asarray(b)
    return float(np.sqrt(np.mean((a-b)**2)))

def mae(a,b):
    a,b=np.asarray(a),np.asarray(b)
    return float(np.mean(np.abs(a-b)))

def max_abs_error(a,b):
    return float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(a)-np.asarray(b))))

    X0_PATH, header=None, nrows=N_STATIC, dtype=np.float32

).to_numpy().reshape(-1)

Xn = normalize(X0_static, normalization["x"]).astype(np.float32)
Un = model(jnp.asarray(Xn))
U0_nn = denormalize(np.asarray(Un), normalization["u"]).reshape(-1)
U0_nn = np.clip(U0_nn, -9, 9)

display(pd.DataFrame([{
    "RMSE_u": rmse(U0_mpc, U0_nn),
    "MAE_u": mae(U0_mpc, U0_nn),

16. Regla para las futuras cuantizaciones¶

Para PTQ, QAT, INT16x8 o Mixed Precision se deben conservar sin cambios:

  • X0_TEST;
  • 200 condiciones iniciales;
  • semilla PRNGKey(100);
  • (T_s=0.16) s;
  • 100 pasos / 16 s;
  • misma dinámica;
  • mismo odeint;
  • clip ([-9,9]);
  • check_constraints_original();
  • check_final_state_constraints_original().

Así, cualquier cambio en Success_Rate puede atribuirse a la representación/cuanti­zación de la red y no a un cambio en el banco de pruebas.

Nota: el paper también usa una red de sensibilidades de 8 capas para el AMPC adaptativo. Este notebook fija el baseline de la política nominal (\pi_{NN}) con parámetros nominales. Para reproducir la Figura 3 completa es necesario cargar además model_8x50_aug y su normalization.p.

Transferencia exacta de pesos¶

En Equinox:

$y=Wx+b$

con:

$W_{eqx}.shape = (out, in)$

En Keras:

$W_{keras}.shape = (in, out)$

Por tanto necesitas transponer:

$W_{keras}=W_{eqx}^{T}$

for i, (layer_eqx, layer_keras) in enumerate(
    zip(
        model.neural_network.layers,
        modelo_keras.layers
    )
):
    W_eqx = np.asarray(layer_eqx.weight, dtype=np.float32)
    b_eqx = np.asarray(layer_eqx.bias, dtype=np.float32)

    W_keras = W_eqx.T

    layer_keras.set_weights([
        W_keras,
        b_eqx
    ])

    print(
        f"Capa {i}: "
        f"EQX {W_eqx.shape} -> "
        f"Keras {W_keras.shape}"
    )

def call_control_keras(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float32).reshape(1, 4)

    x_norm = normalize(
        x,
        normalization["x"]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    u_norm = modelo_keras(
        x_norm,
        training=False
    ).numpy()

    u = denormalize(
        u_norm,
        normalization["u"]
    )

    return np.clip(
        u.reshape(-1),
        -9.0,
        9.0
    )


def simulate_closed_loop_nominal_keras(x0, n_steps=N_SIM):
    X = np.zeros((n_steps+1, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    U = np.zeros(n_steps, dtype=np.float64)
    X[0] = x0

    for k in range(n_steps):
        # Igual que run_tester_round(): sin wrap del ángulo antes del controlador.
        u = call_control_keras(X[k])
        U[k] = float(u[0])
        X[k+1] = sim_nominal.run(X[k], np.array([U[k]]))
    return X, U



def evaluar_success_rate_float32(X0_test=X0_TEST):
    registros = []
    exitos = 0
    t0 = time.perf_counter()

    for i, x0 in enumerate(X0_test):
        X_i, U_i = simulate_closed_loop_nominal_keras(x0)

        c_ok = check_constraints_original(X_i)
        f_ok = check_final_state_constraints_original(X_i)
        ok = c_ok and f_ok
        exitos += int(ok)

        Xm = mod_pendulum_np(X_i)

        registros.append({
            "id": i,
            "success": ok,
            "constraints_ok": c_ok,
            "final_state_ok": f_ok,
            "y0": x0[0],
            "alpha0": x0[1],
            "y_final": Xm[-1,0],
            "alpha_final": Xm[-1,1],
            "ydot_final": Xm[-1,2],
            "alphadot_final": Xm[-1,3],
            "max_abs_y": np.max(np.abs(Xm[:,0])),
            "max_abs_alpha": np.max(np.abs(Xm[:,1])),
            "u_min": np.min(U_i),
            "u_max": np.max(U_i),
            "saturated_samples": int(np.sum(np.isclose(np.abs(U_i), 9.0, atol=1e-5))),
            "sum_u2": float(np.sum(U_i**2)),
            "TV_u": float(np.sum(np.abs(np.diff(U_i))))
        })

    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0
    df = pd.DataFrame(registros)
    resumen = {
        "Modelo": "Float32_keras",
        "N": len(X0_test),
        "Éxitos": exitos,
        "Fallos": len(X0_test)-exitos,
        "Success_Rate": exitos/len(X0_test),
        "Success_Rate_%": 100*exitos/len(X0_test),
        "Tiempo_evaluacion_s": elapsed
    }
    return df, resumen

# ============================================================
# VALIDACIÓN FINAL EQX vs KERAS + GUARDADO DEL MODELO
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Evaluar EQX y Keras sobre EXACTAMENTE las mismas 200 X0
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resultados_pareados = []

for i, x0 in enumerate(X0_TEST):

    # ----- EQX original -----
    X_eqx, U_eqx_cl = simulate_closed_loop_nominal(x0)

    success_eqx = success_original(X_eqx)

    # ----- Keras transferido -----
    X_keras, U_keras_cl = simulate_closed_loop_nominal_keras(x0)

    success_keras = success_original(X_keras)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Diferencias entre ambos controladores closed-loop
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    max_diff_u = np.max(
        np.abs(U_eqx_cl - U_keras_cl)
    )

    rmse_u_closedloop = np.sqrt(
        np.mean((U_eqx_cl - U_keras_cl)**2)
    )

    max_diff_x = np.max(
        np.abs(X_eqx - X_keras)
    )

    rmse_x_closedloop = np.sqrt(
        np.mean((X_eqx - X_keras)**2)
    )

    resultados_pareados.append({
        "id": i,

        "success_EQX": bool(success_eqx),
        "success_Keras": bool(success_keras),

        "RMSE_u_closedloop": rmse_u_closedloop,
        "MaxAbsDiff_u_closedloop": max_diff_u,

        "RMSE_X_closedloop": rmse_x_closedloop,
        "MaxAbsDiff_X_closedloop": max_diff_x,

        "y0": x0[0],
        "alpha0": x0[1],
    })


df_eqx_vs_keras = pd.DataFrame(resultados_pareados)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Matriz de concordancia
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ambos_exito = np.sum(
    df_eqx_vs_keras["success_EQX"] &
    df_eqx_vs_keras["success_Keras"]
)

solo_eqx = np.sum(
    df_eqx_vs_keras["success_EQX"] &
    ~df_eqx_vs_keras["success_Keras"]
)

solo_keras = np.sum(
    ~df_eqx_vs_keras["success_EQX"] &
    df_eqx_vs_keras["success_Keras"]
)

ambos_fallo = np.sum(
    ~df_eqx_vs_keras["success_EQX"] &
    ~df_eqx_vs_keras["success_Keras"]
)


success_rate_eqx = (
    df_eqx_vs_keras["success_EQX"].mean() * 100
)

success_rate_keras = (
    df_eqx_vs_keras["success_Keras"].mean() * 100
)


print("=" * 65)
print("VALIDACIÓN FINAL EQX vs KERAS")
print("=" * 65)

print(f"\nSuccess Rate EQX   : {success_rate_eqx:.2f} %")
print(f"Success Rate Keras : {success_rate_keras:.2f} %")

print("\nConcordancia de las 200 condiciones iniciales:")
print(f"Ambos éxito       : {ambos_exito}")
print(f"Solo EQX éxito    : {solo_eqx}")
print(f"Solo Keras éxito  : {solo_keras}")
print(f"Ambos fallo       : {ambos_fallo}")

print("\nDiferencias closed-loop EQX vs Keras:")
print(
    "RMSE(u) promedio       :",
    df_eqx_vs_keras["RMSE_u_closedloop"].mean()
)

print(
    "Max |Δu| global        :",
    df_eqx_vs_keras["MaxAbsDiff_u_closedloop"].max()
)

print(
    "RMSE(X) promedio       :",
    df_eqx_vs_keras["RMSE_X_closedloop"].mean()
)

print(
    "Max |ΔX| global        :",
    df_eqx_vs_keras["MaxAbsDiff_X_closedloop"].max()
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Mostrar solamente los casos donde cambia éxito/fallo
# ------------------------------------------------------------

casos_discordantes = df_eqx_vs_keras[
    df_eqx_vs_keras["success_EQX"] !=
    df_eqx_vs_keras["success_Keras"]
].copy()

print("\nCasos donde EQX y Keras producen distinta clasificación")
print("de éxito/fallo:")

display(casos_discordantes)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Guardar resultados de validación
# ------------------------------------------------------------

VALIDATION_DIR = Path("resultados_validacion_eqx_keras")
VALIDATION_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

df_eqx_vs_keras.to_csv(

casos_discordantes.to_csv(

MODEL_EXPORT_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

KERAS_MODEL_PATH = (

# ============================================================
# CELDA AUXILIAR COMÚN
# Dataset representativo + utilidades TFLite + closed-loop
# ============================================================

import time

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Directorio de modelos cuantizados
# ------------------------------------------------------------

OUTPUT_TFLITE = Path("modelos_cuantizados")
OUTPUT_TFLITE.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. DATASET REPRESENTATIVO
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Usamos X0.csv porque la entrada de la política es:
#
# [y, alpha, y_dot, alpha_dot] -> u
#
# IMPORTANTE:
# modelo_keras recibe entradas NORMALIZADAS.
# Por lo tanto, el representative dataset también debe estar
# normalizado exactamente como durante la inferencia original.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

N_REPRESENTATIVE = 5000
SEED_REPRESENTATIVE = 100

# X0.csv es relativamente pequeño frente a X.csv:
# 368000 x 4 aprox., por lo que podemos cargarlo completo.
X0_all_rep = pd.read_csv(
    X0_PATH,
    header=None,
    dtype=np.float32
).to_numpy()

rng_rep = np.random.default_rng(SEED_REPRESENTATIVE)

idx_rep = rng_rep.choice(
    len(X0_all_rep),
    size=min(N_REPRESENTATIVE, len(X0_all_rep)),
    replace=False
)

X_rep = X0_all_rep[idx_rep]

X_rep_norm = normalize(
    X_rep,
    normalization["x"]
).astype(np.float32)

print("=" * 65)
print("DATASET REPRESENTATIVO")
print("=" * 65)

print("X_rep físico      :", X_rep.shape)
print("X_rep normalizado :", X_rep_norm.shape)

for i, name in enumerate(["y", "alpha", "y_dot", "alpha_dot"]):
    print(
        f"{name:10s}: "
        f"min={X_rep_norm[:,i].min(): .6f} | "
        f"max={X_rep_norm[:,i].max(): .6f}"
    )


def representative_dataset():
    """
    Generador utilizado por TFLite para calibración PTQ.
    """
    for i in range(len(X_rep_norm)):
        yield [
            X_rep_norm[i:i+1].astype(np.float32)
        ]


# ============================================================
# 2. UTILIDAD: INSPECCIONAR CUANTIZACIÓN DEL .TFLITE
# ============================================================

def auditar_tflite(model_path, mostrar_tensores=False):

    interpreter = tf.lite.Interpreter(
        model_path=str(model_path)
    )

    interpreter.allocate_tensors()

    input_details = interpreter.get_input_details()
    output_details = interpreter.get_output_details()
    tensor_details = interpreter.get_tensor_details()

    print("\n" + "=" * 65)
    print("AUDITORÍA TFLITE")
    print("=" * 65)

    print("\nEntrada:")
    print(" dtype :", input_details[0]["dtype"])
    print(" shape :", input_details[0]["shape"])
    print(
        " quant :",
        input_details[0]["quantization"]
    )

    print("\nSalida:")
    print(" dtype :", output_details[0]["dtype"])
    print(" shape :", output_details[0]["shape"])
    print(
        " quant :",
        output_details[0]["quantization"]
    )

    n_per_tensor = 0
    n_per_channel = 0

    per_channel_names = []

    for tensor in tensor_details:

        qp = tensor.get(
            "quantization_parameters",
            {}
        )

        scales = qp.get(
            "scales",
            np.array([])
        )

        if len(scales) == 1:
            n_per_tensor += 1

        elif len(scales) > 1:
            n_per_channel += 1
            per_channel_names.append(
                (
                    tensor["name"],
                    len(scales),
                    qp.get(
                        "quantized_dimension",
                        None
                    )
                )
            )

    print("\nTensores cuantizados:")
    print(" Per-tensor :", n_per_tensor)
    print(" Per-channel:", n_per_channel)

    if n_per_channel > 0:

        print("\nTensores realmente per-channel:")

        for name, n_scales, dim in per_channel_names:
            print(
                f" - {name}"
                f" | escalas={n_scales}"
                f" | quantized_dimension={dim}"
            )

    if mostrar_tensores:

        print("\nDetalle de tensores:")

        for tensor in tensor_details:

            qp = tensor.get(
                "quantization_parameters",
                {}
            )

            scales = qp.get(
                "scales",
                []
            )

            print(
                tensor["name"],
                tensor["dtype"],
                "n_scales=",
                len(scales)
            )

    return {
        "input_dtype":
            input_details[0]["dtype"],
        "output_dtype":
            output_details[0]["dtype"],
        "per_tensor_tensors":
            n_per_tensor,
        "per_channel_tensors":
            n_per_channel,
    }


# ============================================================
# 3. CLASE DE INFERENCIA TFLITE
# ============================================================

class TFLiteController:

    def __init__(self, model_path):

        self.model_path = str(model_path)

        self.interpreter = tf.lite.Interpreter(
            model_path=self.model_path
        )

        self.interpreter.allocate_tensors()

        self.input_detail = (
            self.interpreter
            .get_input_details()[0]
        )

        self.output_detail = (
            self.interpreter
            .get_output_details()[0]
        )


    @staticmethod
    def _quantize(x, detail):

        dtype = detail["dtype"]

        if np.issubdtype(
            dtype,
            np.floating
        ):
            return x.astype(dtype)

        scale, zero_point = (
            detail["quantization"]
        )

        if scale == 0:
            raise ValueError(
                "Escala de cuantización de entrada = 0."
            )

        q = np.round(
            x / scale + zero_point
        )

        info = np.iinfo(dtype)

        q = np.clip(
            q,
            info.min,
            info.max
        )

        return q.astype(dtype)


    @staticmethod
    def _dequantize(y, detail):

        dtype = detail["dtype"]

        if np.issubdtype(
            dtype,
            np.floating
        ):
            return y.astype(np.float32)

        scale, zero_point = (
            detail["quantization"]
        )

        return (
            scale *
            (
                y.astype(np.float32)
                -
                zero_point
            )
        )


    def predict_normalized(self, x_norm):

        x_norm = np.asarray(
            x_norm,
            dtype=np.float32
        ).reshape(1, 4)

        x_input = self._quantize(
            x_norm,
            self.input_detail
        )

        self.interpreter.set_tensor(
            self.input_detail["index"],
            x_input
        )

        self.interpreter.invoke()

        y = self.interpreter.get_tensor(
            self.output_detail["index"]
        )

        y = self._dequantize(
            y,
            self.output_detail
        )

        return y.reshape(-1)


    def control(self, x):

        # Igual que modelo_keras:
        # estado físico -> normalización -> red
        x = np.asarray(
            x,
            dtype=np.float32
        ).reshape(1, 4)

        x_norm = normalize(
            x,
            normalization["x"]
        ).astype(np.float32)

        u_norm = self.predict_normalized(
            x_norm
        )

        # Salida normalizada -> voltios
        u = denormalize(
            u_norm,
            normalization["u"]
        )

        return np.clip(
            np.asarray(u).reshape(-1),
            -9.0,
            9.0
        )


# ============================================================
# 4. SIMULACIÓN CLOSED-LOOP PARA CUALQUIER TFLITE
# ============================================================

def simulate_closed_loop_tflite(
    controller,
    x0,
    n_steps=N_SIM
):

    X = np.zeros(
        (n_steps + 1, 4),
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    U = np.zeros(
        n_steps,
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    X[0] = np.asarray(
        x0,
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    for k in range(n_steps):

        u = controller.control(
            X[k]
        )

        U[k] = float(u[0])

        X[k+1] = sim_nominal.run(
            X[k],
            np.array([U[k]])
        )

    return X, U


# ============================================================
# 5. SUCCESS RATE PARA CUALQUIER .TFLITE
# ============================================================

def evaluar_tflite_closed_loop(
    model_path,
    nombre_modelo,
    X0_test=X0_TEST
):

    controller = TFLiteController(
        model_path
    )

    resultados = []

    exitos = 0

    t0 = time.perf_counter()

    for i, x0 in enumerate(X0_test):

        X_i, U_i = (
            simulate_closed_loop_tflite(
                controller,
                x0
            )
        )

        constraints_ok = (
            check_constraints_original(
                X_i
            )
        )

        final_ok = (
            check_final_state_constraints_original(
                X_i
            )
        )

        success = (
            constraints_ok
            and
            final_ok
        )

        exitos += int(success)

        resultados.append({
            "id": i,
            "success": success,
            "constraints_ok":
                constraints_ok,
            "final_state_ok":
                final_ok,
            "y0": x0[0],
            "alpha0": x0[1],
            "u_max":
                np.max(U_i),
            "u_min":
                np.min(U_i),
            "TV_u":
                np.sum(
                    np.abs(
                        np.diff(U_i)
                    )
                ),
        })

    elapsed = (
        time.perf_counter()
        -
        t0
    )

    df = pd.DataFrame(
        resultados
    )

    resumen = {
        "Modelo":
            nombre_modelo,
        "N":
            len(X0_test),
        "Éxitos":
            exitos,
        "Fallos":
            len(X0_test) - exitos,
        "Success_Rate":
            exitos / len(X0_test),
        "Success_Rate_%":
            100 * exitos / len(X0_test),
        "Tiempo_evaluacion_s":
            elapsed,
    }

    print("\n" + "=" * 65)
    print(nombre_modelo)
    print("=" * 65)

    display(
        pd.DataFrame(
            [resumen]
        )
    )

    return df, resumen


print("\n✓ Utilidades de cuantización preparadas.")

QAT INT8¶

Para QAT utilizamos:

$X_{0}→U_{0}$

porque ahora sí necesitamos supervisión. U.csv contiene las secuencias de control y la primera columna corresponde a la primera acción MPC aplicada por la política aproximada.

In [33]:
# ============================================================
# 3. QAT INT8
# Quantization Aware Training
# Compatible con TFMOT + tf_keras
# ============================================================

import tensorflow as tf
import tensorflow_model_optimization as tfmot
import tf_keras

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Dataset QAT
# ------------------------------------------------------------

N_QAT = 50000
SEED_QAT = 123


# Leer X0 completo
X_qat_all = pd.read_csv(
    X0_PATH,
    header=None,
    dtype=np.float32
).to_numpy()


# Solo primera acción MPC U[:,0]
U_qat_all = pd.read_csv(
    U_PATH,
    header=None,
    usecols=[0],
    dtype=np.float32
).to_numpy()


assert len(X_qat_all) == len(U_qat_all)


rng_qat = np.random.default_rng(
    SEED_QAT
)

idx_qat = rng_qat.choice(
    len(X_qat_all),
    size=min(
        N_QAT,
        len(X_qat_all)
    ),
    replace=False
)


X_qat = X_qat_all[idx_qat]
U_qat = U_qat_all[idx_qat]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Normalización EXACTAMENTE igual que el original
# ------------------------------------------------------------

X_qat_norm = normalize(
    X_qat,
    normalization["x"]
).astype(np.float32)


U_qat_norm = normalize(
    U_qat,
    normalization["u"]
).astype(np.float32)


print("X QAT:", X_qat_norm.shape)
print("U QAT:", U_qat_norm.shape)


# ============================================================
# 3. RECONSTRUIR EL MODELO ORIGINAL EN tf_keras
# ============================================================
#
# Arquitectura original:
#
# 4
# -> Dense(50, tanh)
# -> Dense(50, tanh)
# -> Dense(50, tanh)
# -> Dense(50, tanh)
# -> Dense(50, tanh)
# -> Dense(50, tanh)
# -> Dense(50, tanh)
# -> Dense(1, linear)
#
# ============================================================

modelo_qat_base = tf_keras.Sequential(
    [
        tf_keras.layers.Input(
            shape=(4,),
            name="input_state"
        ),

        tf_keras.layers.Dense(
            50,
            activation="tanh",
            name="dense_0"
        ),

        tf_keras.layers.Dense(
            50,
            activation="tanh",
            name="dense_1"
        ),

        tf_keras.layers.Dense(
            50,
            activation="tanh",
            name="dense_2"
        ),

        tf_keras.layers.Dense(
            50,
            activation="tanh",
            name="dense_3"
        ),

        tf_keras.layers.Dense(
            50,
            activation="tanh",
            name="dense_4"
        ),

        tf_keras.layers.Dense(
            50,
            activation="tanh",
            name="dense_5"
        ),

        tf_keras.layers.Dense(
            50,
            activation="tanh",
            name="dense_6"
        ),

        tf_keras.layers.Dense(
            1,
            activation=None,
            name="output_u"
        )
    ],
    name="AMPC_CartPole_QAT_Base"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Copiar pesos EXACTOS desde modelo_keras
# ------------------------------------------------------------

modelo_qat_base.set_weights(
    modelo_keras.get_weights()
)


print("\nModelo tf_keras reconstruido:")
modelo_qat_base.summary()


# ============================================================
# 5. VALIDAR EQUIVALENCIA ANTES DEL QAT
# ============================================================

N_EQUIV_QAT = min(
    10000,
    len(X_qat_norm)
)

X_equiv_qat = X_qat_norm[
    :N_EQUIV_QAT
]


# Modelo original Keras 3
U_original = modelo_keras.predict(
    X_equiv_qat,
    verbose=0
).reshape(-1)


# Copia tf_keras
U_tfkeras = modelo_qat_base.predict(
    X_equiv_qat,
    verbose=0
).reshape(-1)


error_transferencia = (
    U_tfkeras
    -
    U_original
)


rmse_transferencia = np.sqrt(
    np.mean(
        error_transferencia**2
    )
)

mae_transferencia = np.mean(
    np.abs(
        error_transferencia
    )
)

max_transferencia = np.max(
    np.abs(
        error_transferencia
    )
)


print("\n" + "=" * 65)
print("VALIDACIÓN KERAS ORIGINAL vs tf_keras")
print("=" * 65)

print(
    "RMSE:",
    rmse_transferencia
)

print(
    "MAE :",
    mae_transferencia
)

print(
    "MAX :",
    max_transferencia
)


if rmse_transferencia < 1e-5:
    print(
        "\n✓ Transferencia de pesos correcta."
    )
else:
    print(
        "\n⚠ Revisar transferencia antes de aplicar QAT."
    )


# ============================================================
# 6. FAKE QUANTIZATION
# ============================================================

modelo_qat = (
    tfmot.quantization.keras
    .quantize_model(
        modelo_qat_base
    )
)


print("\n✓ Fake Quantization aplicada.")

modelo_qat.summary()


# ============================================================
# 7. COMPILAR QAT
# ============================================================

modelo_qat.compile(
    optimizer=
        tf_keras.optimizers.Adam(
            learning_rate=1e-5
        ),

    loss="mse",

    metrics=[
        "mae"
    ]
)


# ============================================================
# 8. FINE-TUNING QAT
# ============================================================

callbacks_qat = [
    tf_keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping(
        monitor="val_loss",
        patience=4,
        restore_best_weights=True
    )
]


history_qat = modelo_qat.fit(
    X_qat_norm,
    U_qat_norm,

    validation_split=0.10,

    epochs=20,

    batch_size=256,

    shuffle=True,

    callbacks=
        callbacks_qat,

    verbose=1
)


# ============================================================
# 9. CONVERTIR QAT -> INT8 TFLITE
# ============================================================

converter = (
    tf.lite.TFLiteConverter
    .from_keras_model(
        modelo_qat
    )
)


converter.optimizations = [
    tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT
]


converter.representative_dataset = (
    representative_dataset
)


converter.target_spec.supported_ops = [
    tf.lite.OpsSet.TFLITE_BUILTINS_INT8
]


converter.inference_input_type = (
    tf.int8
)

converter.inference_output_type = (
    tf.int8
)

Mixed Precision selectiva¶

In [57]:
# ============================================================
# 5. MIXED PRECISION SELECTIVA PARA CONTROL - FINAL
# ============================================================
#
# Estrategia:
#
# SIEMPRE Float32:
#   - dense_0
#   - output_u
#
# SELECTIVO:
#   - dense_1 ... dense_6
#   - Float32 si:
#
#           RMSE / scale > UMBRAL_ERROR
#
# El resto puede permanecer cuantizado.
#
# IMPORTANTE:
# denylisted_nodes usa DIRECTAMENTE los "tensor_name"
# obtenidos mediante layer_statistics_dump().
#
# ============================================================

import tensorflow as tf
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import re
from pathlib import Path


# ============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURACIÓN
# ============================================================

UMBRAL_ERROR = 0.32

# Algunos valores que puedes probar:
#
# 1.50 -> pocas capas internas Float32
# 1.00
# 0.70 -> buen punto inicial
# 0.50
# 0.30
# 0.00 -> prácticamente todas las capas identificadas
#
# IMPORTANTE:
# ahora el umbral corresponde a RMSE/scale,
# NO al RMSE absoluto usado anteriormente.


PATH_MIXED = (
    OUTPUT_TFLITE /
    "AMPC_CartPole_MixedPrecision.tflite"
)

PATH_DEBUG_CSV = (
    OUTPUT_TFLITE /
    "_mixed_quant_debug_stats.csv"
)


print("=" * 80)
print("MIXED PRECISION SELECTIVA PARA CONTROL")
print("=" * 80)

print(
    f"Umbral RMSE/scale = {UMBRAL_ERROR}"
)


# ============================================================
# 2. CONVERTER PARA QUANTIZATION DEBUGGER
# ============================================================

converter_debug = (
    tf.lite.TFLiteConverter
    .from_keras_model(
        modelo_keras
    )
)

converter_debug.optimizations = [
    tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT
]

converter_debug.representative_dataset = (
    representative_dataset
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# QuantizationDebugger
# ------------------------------------------------------------

debugger = (
    tf.lite.experimental
    .QuantizationDebugger(
        converter=converter_debug,
        debug_dataset=representative_dataset
    )
)


print("\nEjecutando QuantizationDebugger...")

debugger.run()


# ============================================================
# 3. EXPORTAR ESTADÍSTICAS MEDIANTE layer_statistics_dump()
# ============================================================

with open(
    PATH_DEBUG_CSV,
    "w",
    newline=""
) as f:

    debugger.layer_statistics_dump(f)


layer_stats = pd.read_csv(
    PATH_DEBUG_CSV
)


print("\nColumnas obtenidas:")
print(
    layer_stats.columns.tolist()
)


print("\nPrimeras filas:")

display(
    layer_stats.head(20)
)


# ============================================================
# 4. COMPROBAR COLUMNAS NECESARIAS
# ============================================================

columnas_necesarias = [
    "tensor_name",
    "mean_squared_error",
]


faltantes = [
    c
    for c in columnas_necesarias
    if c not in layer_stats.columns
]


if faltantes:

    raise RuntimeError(
        "Faltan columnas necesarias en "
        "layer_statistics_dump(): "
        f"{faltantes}\n"
        f"Columnas obtenidas: "
        f"{layer_stats.columns.tolist()}"
    )


# ============================================================
# 5. CALCULAR RMSE
# ============================================================

layer_stats["rmse"] = np.sqrt(
    layer_stats[
        "mean_squared_error"
    ].astype(np.float64)
)


# ============================================================
# 6. OBTENER SCALE
# ============================================================
#
# layer_statistics_dump normalmente incluye "scale".
# Si existe, usamos RMSE/scale.
#
# ============================================================

if "scale" not in layer_stats.columns:

    raise RuntimeError(
        "El CSV generado por layer_statistics_dump() "
        "no contiene la columna 'scale'.\n"
        "No se puede calcular RMSE/scale de forma fiable.\n"
        f"Columnas disponibles: "
        f"{layer_stats.columns.tolist()}"
    )


layer_stats["scale"] = (
    layer_stats["scale"]
    .astype(np.float64)
)


# Evitar división por cero
layer_stats["rmse_scale"] = np.where(
    layer_stats["scale"] > 0,
    layer_stats["rmse"] /
    layer_stats["scale"],
    np.nan
)


# ============================================================
# 7. IDENTIFICAR CAPA A PARTIR DE tensor_name
# ============================================================

def identificar_capa(nombre):

    nombre = str(nombre)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Capas dense_0 ... dense_6
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    match = re.search(
        r"(dense_\d+)",
        nombre
    )

    if match:
        return match.group(1)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Capa de salida
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if "output_u" in nombre:
        return "output_u"


    # En algunos modelos la salida aparece como
    # StatefulPartitionedCall
    if "StatefulPartitionedCall" in nombre:
        return "output_u"


    return None


layer_stats["layer"] = (
    layer_stats[
        "tensor_name"
    ]
    .apply(
        identificar_capa
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 8. MOSTRAR ESTADÍSTICAS COMPLETAS
# ============================================================

columnas_mostrar = [
    c for c in [
        "op_name",
        "tensor_name",
        "layer",
        "scale",
        "rmse",
        "rmse_scale",
    ]
    if c in layer_stats.columns
]


print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("ESTADÍSTICAS DE CUANTIZACIÓN")
print("=" * 80)

display(
    layer_stats[
        columnas_mostrar
    ].sort_values(
        "rmse_scale",
        ascending=False,
        na_position="last"
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 9. ERROR REPRESENTATIVO POR CAPA DENSE
# ============================================================
#
# Puede haber varios tensor_name pertenecientes a una misma
# Dense (por ejemplo salida de FullyConnected y Tanh).
#
# Para decidir si una capa debe mantenerse Float32,
# usamos el MAYOR RMSE/scale detectado dentro de esa capa.
#
# ============================================================

layer_stats_validas = (
    layer_stats[
        layer_stats["layer"].notna()
    ]
    .copy()
)


error_por_capa = (
    layer_stats_validas
    .groupby(
        "layer",
        as_index=False
    )["rmse_scale"]
    .max()
    .sort_values(
        "rmse_scale",
        ascending=False
    )
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)


print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("RANKING DE SENSIBILIDAD POR CAPA")
print("=" * 80)

display(
    error_por_capa
)


# ============================================================
# 10. SELECCIÓN DE CAPAS INTERNAS
# ============================================================
#
# dense_0:
#   siempre Float32.
#
# output_u:
#   siempre Float32.
#
# dense_1 ... dense_6:
#   Float32 solo si RMSE/scale > UMBRAL_ERROR.
#
# ============================================================



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Capas que SIEMPRE queremos mantener Float32
# por criterio de control
# ------------------------------------------------------------

CAPAS_FLOAT32_FIJAS = [
    "dense_0",
    "output_u",
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Capas que tú quieres agregar manualmente
#
# Puedes modificar SOLO esta lista.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

CAPAS_FLOAT32_MANUALES = [
    # "dense_1",
    # "dense_2",
    # "dense_3",
    # "dense_4",
    #"dense_5",
    #"dense_6",
]







capas_internas_float32 = (
    error_por_capa[
        (
            error_por_capa[
                "rmse_scale"
            ]
            >
            UMBRAL_ERROR
        )
        &
        (
            ~error_por_capa[
                "layer"
            ].isin(
                [
                    "dense_0",
                    "output_u"
                ]
            )
        )
    ]["layer"]
    .tolist()
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combinar:
#
# 1. Fijas
# 2. Automáticas por RMSE/scale
# 3. Manuales
# ------------------------------------------------------------

capas_float32 = (
    CAPAS_FLOAT32_FIJAS
    +
    capas_internas_float32
    +
    CAPAS_FLOAT32_MANUALES
)


for capa in capas_internas_float32:

    if capa not in capas_float32:
        capas_float32.append(capa)


# output_u siempre al final
capas_float32.append(
    "output_u"
)

# Eliminar duplicados manteniendo orden
capas_float32 = list(
    dict.fromkeys(
        capas_float32
    )
)

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("CAPAS SOLICITADAS EN FLOAT32")
print("=" * 80)


print("\nObligatorias:")

print(
    " - dense_0"
)

print(
    " - output_u"
)


print("\nSeleccionadas por RMSE/scale:")


if len(capas_internas_float32) == 0:

    print(
        " - Ninguna"
    )

else:

    for capa in capas_internas_float32:

        valor = (
            error_por_capa.loc[
                error_por_capa["layer"]
                ==
                capa,
                "rmse_scale"
            ]
            .iloc[0]
        )

        print(
            f" - {capa:10s}"
            f" | RMSE/scale = "
            f"{valor:.6f}"
        )


# ============================================================
# 11. OBTENER tensor_name DIRECTAMENTE DEL DUMP
# ============================================================
#
# CRÍTICO:
#
# NO:
#   - quitar NumericVerify
#   - agregar MatMul
#   - agregar BiasAdd
#   - modificar :35, :39, etc.
#
# Se usa EXACTAMENTE tensor_name.
#
# ============================================================

tensor_names_float32 = (
    layer_stats.loc[
        layer_stats[
            "layer"
        ].isin(
            capas_float32
        ),
        "tensor_name"
    ]
    .dropna()
    .astype(str)
    .drop_duplicates()
    .tolist()
)


print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("tensor_name ENVIADOS A denylisted_nodes")
print("=" * 80)


for nombre in tensor_names_float32:

    print(
        " -",
        nombre
    )


if len(tensor_names_float32) == 0:

    raise RuntimeError(
        "La lista denylisted_nodes quedó vacía."
    )


# ============================================================
# 12. CONVERTER MIXED PRECISION
# ============================================================

converter_mixed = (
    tf.lite.TFLiteConverter
    .from_keras_model(
        modelo_keras
    )
)


converter_mixed.optimizations = [
    tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT
]


converter_mixed.representative_dataset = (
    representative_dataset
)


# ============================================================
# 13. SELECTIVE QUANTIZATION
# ============================================================

debug_options_mixed = (
    tf.lite.experimental
    .QuantizationDebugOptions(
        denylisted_nodes=
            tensor_names_float32
    )
)


debugger_mixed = (
    tf.lite.experimental
    .QuantizationDebugger(
        converter=
            converter_mixed,

        debug_dataset=
            representative_dataset,

        debug_options=
            debug_options_mixed
    )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Obtener modelo cuantizado final SIN instrumentación debug
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tflite_mixed = (
    debugger_mixed
    .get_nondebug_quantized_model()
)


# ============================================================
# 14. SOBRESCRIBIR ARCHIVO
# ============================================================

PATH_MIXED.write_bytes(
    tflite_mixed
)


print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("MODELO MIXED GENERADO")
print("=" * 80)


print(
    "Archivo:",
    PATH_MIXED
)

print(
    "Tamaño:",
    PATH_MIXED.stat().st_size,
    "bytes"
)


# ============================================================
# 15. CARGAR MODELO PARA AUDITORÍA
# ============================================================

interpreter_mixed = (
    tf.lite.Interpreter(
        model_path=str(
            PATH_MIXED
        )
    )
)


interpreter_mixed.allocate_tensors()


tensor_details = {
    t["index"]: t
    for t in
    interpreter_mixed
    .get_tensor_details()
}


ops_details = (
    interpreter_mixed
    ._get_ops_details()
)


# ============================================================
# 16. CLASIFICADOR DE OPERADORES
# ============================================================

def clasificar_operador(
    op,
    tensor_details
):

    input_types = []


    for idx in op["inputs"]:

        if idx < 0:
            continue

        if idx in tensor_details:

            input_types.append(
                tensor_details[
                    idx
                ]["dtype"]
            )


    output_types = []


    for idx in op["outputs"]:

        if idx < 0:
            continue

        if idx in tensor_details:

            output_types.append(
                tensor_details[
                    idx
                ]["dtype"]
            )


    op_name = op["op_name"]


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Conversiones
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if op_name in [
        "QUANTIZE",
        "DEQUANTIZE"
    ]:

        return (
            "CONVERSION",
            input_types,
            output_types
        )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Float32 puro
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        len(output_types) > 0
        and
        all(
            dtype == np.float32
            for dtype in output_types
        )
        and
        all(
            dtype == np.float32
            for dtype in input_types
        )
    ):

        return (
            "FLOAT32",
            input_types,
            output_types
        )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # INT8
    #
    # En FullyConnected INT8:
    #
    # activación : int8
    # pesos      : int8
    # bias       : int32
    # salida     : int8
    #
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        len(output_types) > 0
        and
        all(
            dtype == np.int8
            for dtype in output_types
        )
        and
        all(
            dtype in [
                np.int8,
                np.int32
            ]
            for dtype in input_types
        )
    ):

        return (
            "INT8",
            input_types,
            output_types
        )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Mixed interno
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    tiene_float = (
        np.float32 in input_types
        or
        np.float32 in output_types
    )

    tiene_int = (
        np.int8 in input_types
        or
        np.int8 in output_types
        or
        np.int32 in input_types
    )


    if (
        tiene_float
        and
        tiene_int
    ):

        return (
            "MIXED",
            input_types,
            output_types
        )


    return (
        "OTHER",
        input_types,
        output_types
    )


# ============================================================
# 17. AUDITORÍA COMPLETA
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("AUDITORÍA DEL GRAFO TFLITE")
print("=" * 80)


n_float32 = 0
n_int8 = 0
n_conversion = 0
n_mixed = 0
n_other = 0


for i, op in enumerate(
    ops_details
):

    # XNNPACK / delegate
    if op["op_name"] == "DELEGATE":
        continue


    precision, inputs, outputs = (
        clasificar_operador(
            op,
            tensor_details
        )
    )


    if precision == "FLOAT32":

        n_float32 += 1

    elif precision == "INT8":

        n_int8 += 1

    elif precision == "CONVERSION":

        n_conversion += 1

    elif precision == "MIXED":

        n_mixed += 1

    else:

        n_other += 1


    print(
        f"{i:02d} | "
        f"{op['op_name']:20s} | "
        f"{precision:10s} | "
        f"IN={inputs} | "
        f"OUT={outputs}"
    )


print("\nResumen operadores:")

print(
    "FLOAT32    :",
    n_float32
)

print(
    "INT8       :",
    n_int8
)

print(
    "MIXED      :",
    n_mixed
)

print(
    "CONVERSION :",
    n_conversion
)

print(
    "OTHER      :",
    n_other
)


# ============================================================
# 18. IDENTIFICAR LOS 8 FULLY_CONNECTED
# ============================================================

fully_connected_ops = []


for i, op in enumerate(
    ops_details
):

    if op["op_name"] != "FULLY_CONNECTED":
        continue


    precision, inputs, outputs = (
        clasificar_operador(
            op,
            tensor_details
        )
    )


    fully_connected_ops.append(
        {
            "index": i,
            "precision": precision,
            "inputs": inputs,
            "outputs": outputs
        }
    )


nombres_fc = [
    "dense_0",
    "dense_1",
    "dense_2",
    "dense_3",
    "dense_4",
    "dense_5",
    "dense_6",
    "output_u",
]


precision_por_capa = {}


print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("PRECISIÓN REAL DE CADA FULLY_CONNECTED")
print("=" * 80)


if (
    len(fully_connected_ops)
    !=
    len(nombres_fc)
):

    print(
        "⚠ Número inesperado de FullyConnected:"
    )

    print(
        "Esperados:",
        len(nombres_fc)
    )

    print(
        "Encontrados:",
        len(fully_connected_ops)
    )


for nombre, info in zip(
    nombres_fc,
    fully_connected_ops
):

    precision_por_capa[
        nombre
    ] = info["precision"]


    print(
        f"{nombre:10s}"
        f" -> "
        f"{info['precision']}"
    )


# ============================================================
# 19. VALIDAR CAPAS SOLICITADAS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("VERIFICACIÓN DE SELECTIVE QUANTIZATION")
print("=" * 80)


conversion_valida = True


for capa in capas_float32:

    precision_real = (
        precision_por_capa.get(
            capa,
            "NO_ENCONTRADA"
        )
    )


    print(
        f"{capa:10s}"
        f" | solicitado=FLOAT32"
        f" | real={precision_real}"
    )


    if (
        precision_real
        !=
        "FLOAT32"
    ):

        conversion_valida = False


# ============================================================
# 20. SANITY CHECK
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("SANITY CHECK")
print("=" * 80)


if conversion_valida:

    print(
        "✓ Todas las FullyConnected solicitadas "
        "quedaron realmente Float32."
    )

else:

    print(
        "❌ Una o más FullyConnected solicitadas "
        "siguen cuantizadas."
    )

    print(
        "\nNO interpretar el modelo como "
        "Mixed Precision válido todavía."
    )


# ============================================================
# 21. AUDITORÍA DE TENSORES
# ============================================================

audit_mixed = (
    auditar_tflite(
        PATH_MIXED,
        mostrar_tensores=False
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 22. CLOSED-LOOP
# ============================================================
#
# Solo se ejecuta si la selective quantization
# realmente produjo las precisiones solicitadas.
#
# ============================================================

if conversion_valida:

    df_mixed, resumen_mixed = (
        evaluar_tflite_closed_loop(
            PATH_MIXED,
            (
                f"Mixed_Control_"
                f"RMSEscale_{UMBRAL_ERROR}"
            )
        )
    )

else:

    df_mixed = None
    resumen_mixed = None


    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("CLOSED-LOOP NO EJECUTADO")
    print("=" * 80)

    print(
        "La estructura interna del modelo "
        "no coincide con la precisión solicitada."

# ============================================================
# 23. RESUMEN FINAL
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("RESUMEN MIXED PRECISION")
print("=" * 80)


print(

)


print(
    "Capas FP32 solicitadas :",
    capas_float32
)


print(
    f"Ops Float32             : "
    f"{n_float32}"
)

print(
    f"Ops INT8                : "
    f"{n_int8}"
)

print(
    f"Conversiones            : "
    f"{n_conversion}"
)


print(
    f"Tamaño TFLite           : "
    f"{PATH_MIXED.stat().st_size} bytes"
)


print(
    f"Conversión válida       : "
    f"{conversion_valida}"
)


if resumen_mixed is not None:

    print(
        f"Success Rate            : "
        f"{resumen_mixed['Success_Rate_%']:.2f} %"

# ============================================================
# CELDA DE GRÁFICOS PARA CUALQUIER MODELO
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def graficar_resultado_control(
    X,
    U,
    nombre_modelo="Modelo",
    DT=DT
):
    """
    Grafica estados y acción de control para una trayectoria closed-loop.

    Parámetros
    ----------
    X : ndarray, shape (N+1, 4)
        Trayectoria de estados:
        [y, alpha, y_dot, alpha_dot]

    U : ndarray, shape (N,)
        Acción de control aplicada.

    nombre_modelo : str
        Nombre mostrado en los títulos.

    DT : float
        Periodo de muestreo.
    """

    labels = [
        "Posición y [m]",
        "Ángulo α [rad]",
        "Velocidad ẏ [m/s]",
        "Velocidad angular α̇ [rad/s]"
    ]

    tx = np.arange(len(X)) * DT
    tu = np.arange(len(U)) * DT

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Estados
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for i, lab in enumerate(labels):

        plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))

        plt.plot(
            tx,
            X[:, i],
            label=nombre_modelo
        )

        plt.axhline(
            0,
            linewidth=1
        )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Posición del carro
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if i == 0:

            # Restricción global original
            plt.axhline(
                0.4,
                linestyle=":",
                label="Restricción global ±0.4 m"
            )

            plt.axhline(
                -0.4,
                linestyle=":"
            )

            # Criterio final original
            plt.axhline(
                0.1,
                linestyle="--",
                label="Criterio final ±0.1 m"
            )

            plt.axhline(
                -0.1,
                linestyle="--"
            )

            # Últimas 10 muestras usadas por los autores
            inicio_ventana_final = (
                len(X) - 10
            ) * DT

            plt.axvline(
                inicio_ventana_final,
                linestyle="-.",
                label="Inicio últimas 10 muestras"
            )

            plt.legend()


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Ángulo del péndulo
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if i == 1:

            plt.axhline(
                0.17,
                linestyle="--",
                label="Criterio final ±0.17 rad"
            )

            plt.axhline(
                -0.17,
                linestyle="--"
            )

            inicio_ventana_final = (
                len(X) - 10
            ) * DT

            plt.axvline(
                inicio_ventana_final,
                linestyle="-.",
                label="Inicio últimas 10 muestras"
            )

            plt.legend()


        plt.xlabel(
            "Tiempo [s]"
        )

        plt.ylabel(
            lab
        )

        plt.title(
            f"{nombre_modelo} — {lab}"
        )

        plt.grid(
            True,
            alpha=0.3
        )

        plt.show()


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Acción de control
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    plt.figure(
        figsize=(10, 4)
    )

    plt.step(
        tu,
        U,
        where="post",
        label=nombre_modelo
    )

    plt.axhline(
        9,
        linestyle=":",
        label="+9 V"
    )

    plt.axhline(
        -9,
        linestyle=":",
        label="-9 V"
    )

    plt.axhline(
        0,
        linewidth=1
    )

    plt.xlabel(
        "Tiempo [s]"
    )

    plt.ylabel(
        "u [V]"
    )

    plt.title(
        f"{nombre_modelo} — Acción de control"
    )

    plt.grid(
        True,
        alpha=0.3
    )

    plt.legend()

    plt.show()


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Resultado del criterio original
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    constraints_ok = (
        check_constraints_original(
            X
        )
    )

    final_ok = (
        check_final_state_constraints_original(
            X
        )
    )

    success = (
        constraints_ok
        and
        final_ok
    )


    print("=" * 60)

    print(
        f"RESULTADO — {nombre_modelo}"
    )

    print("=" * 60)

    print(
        "Estado final:",
        X[-1]
    )

    print(
        "Restricción global:",
        constraints_ok
    )

    print(
        "Criterio final:",
        final_ok
    )

    print(
        "ÉXITO:",
        success
    )

CONCLUSION: Los resultados evidencian que la reducción de precisión numérica a INT8 afecta significativamente el desempeño del controlador neuronal en lazo cerrado. Aunque las variantes PTQ Per-Tensor, PTQ Per-Channel y QAT INT8 permitieron reducir el tamaño del modelo entre aproximadamente 69 % y 77 %, sus tasas de éxito disminuyeron a 37 %, 25 % y 32.5 %, respectivamente. Por el contrario, la cuantización PTQ INT16x8 alcanzó una tasa de éxito de 99 %, prácticamente equivalente al 99.5 % obtenido por el modelo Float32, manteniendo una reducción aproximada del 63.6 % en el tamaño del modelo. La estrategia Mixed Precision logró recuperar parcialmente el desempeño, alcanzando un 78 % de éxito, aunque con un mayor tamaño de modelo que INT16x8. Estos resultados indican que, para esta aplicación de control, preservar una mayor resolución en las activaciones resulta crítico para mantener el comportamiento estabilizante del controlador.
